ModMetaData.name: Haul After Harvest
ModMetaData.author: tk421storm
ModMetaData.description: After harvesting plants, chopping trees, milking or shearing animals, mining or fishing, a colonist hauls the closest haulable item nearby to storage before moving on.\n\nSettings: search radius (default 5 cells), enable for plants / trees / animals / mining / fishing, only colonists with Hauling enabled.
